title: Adi-khanda, part 9 (portion 17)
html:
Pauganda-lila (conclusion): Shachi entrusts her son to the pandits; studies under Vishnu Pandita, Sudarshana and Gangadasa; the first meeting with Vallabhacharya's daughter on the way to the Ganga; Vanamali Acharya's matchmaking — Shachi's refusal, the matchmaker's lament, his meeting with the Lord and Shachi's consent; Vallabhacharya gladly agrees to give his daughter

Raga dhanashi; disha: "Ah, ah!"

একদিন শচী করে ধরি গৌরহরি ।
পঢ়িতে গৌরাঙ্গ দিল নিয়োজিত করি ॥ ৬৯৭ ॥

ekadina śacī kare dhari gaurahari |
paṛhite gaurāṅga dila niẏojita kari || 697 ||

ekadina — one day; shachi — Shachi; kare dhari gaurahari — taking Gaurahari by the hand; padhite — to study; gauranga dila niyojita kari — put Gauranga

697One day Shachi, taking Gaurahari by the hand,
put Gauranga to His studies.

সকল পণ্ডিত-স্থানে পুত্র সমর্পিয়া ।
বোলয়ে কাতরে দেবী বিনয় করিয়া ॥ ৬৯৮ ॥

sakala paṇḍita-sthāne putra samarpiẏā |
bolaẏe kātare debī binaẏa kariẏā || 698 ||

sakala pandita-sthane — to all the pandits; putra samarpiya — entrusting her son; bolaye katare — speaks plaintively; devi — the goddess; vinaya kariya — humbly

698Entrusting her son to all the pandits,
the goddess speaks humbly and plaintively:

পঢ়াইও মোর পুত্রে তোমরা ঠাকুর ।
রাখিবে আপন কাছে না রাখিবে দূর ॥ ৬৯৯ ॥

paṛhāio mora putre tomarā ṭhākura |
rākhibe āpana kāche nā rākhibe dūra || 699 ||

padhaio — teach; mora putre — my son; tomara thakura — you, good sirs; rakhibe apana kachhe — keep near you; na rakhibe dura — do not keep at a distance

699"Teach my son, good sirs;
keep Him close to you, do not keep Him at a distance.

পিতৃশূন্য পুত্র মোর পীরিতি করিবে ।
আপন তনয় হেন ইহারে জানিবে ॥ ৭০০ ॥

pitṛśūnya putra mora pīriti karibe |
āpana tanaẏa hena ihāre jānibe || 700 ||

pitri-shunya putra mora — my fatherless son; piriti karibe — show Him affection; apana tanaya hena — like your own son; ihare janibe — regard Him

700My son has lost His father — be kind to Him;
regard Him as your own son."

শুনিঞা পণ্ডিত সব সঙ্কোচ অন্তরে ।
কহিতে লাগিলা কিছু বিনয়-উত্তরে ॥ ৭০১ ॥

śuniñā paṇḍita saba saṅkoca antare |
kahite lāgilā kichu binaẏa-uttare || 701 ||

shunina — hearing; pandita saba — all the pandits; sankocha antare — abashed at heart; kahite lagila kichhu — began to say; vinaya-uttare — in humble reply

701Hearing this, all the pandits, abashed at heart,
began to answer humbly:

মো সভার ভাগ্য এতদিনে সে জানিল ।
কোটি-সরস্বতী-কান্ত আমরা পাইল ॥ ৭০২ ॥

mo sabhāra bhāgya etadine se jānila |
koṭi-sarasbatī-kānta āmarā pāila || 702 ||

mo sabhara bhagya — our fortune; etadine se janila — today we have come to know; koti-sarasvati-kanta — the Lord of millions of Sarasvatis; amara paila — we have obtained

702"Today we have come to know our good fortune:
we have obtained the Lord of millions of Sarasvatis.1

অখিলে পঢ়াইবে ইহঁ নিজ-প্রেম-নাম ।
সর্বলোক-গুরু ইহঁ সভার প্রধান ॥ ৭০৩ ॥

akhile paṛhāibe ihaṁ nija-prema-nāma |
sarbaloka-guru ihaṁ sabhāra pradhāna || 703 ||

akhile padhaibe — will teach the whole world; ihan — He; nija-prema-nama — His own prema and name; sarvaloka-guru ihan — He is the teacher of all people; sabhara pradhana — the foremost of all

703He will teach the whole world His own prema and His name;
He is the teacher of all people, the foremost of all.

আমরাহ পঢ়ব ইহাঁর সন্নিধানে ।
নিশ্চয় জানিহ মাতা কহিল বচনে ॥ ৭০৪ ॥

āmarāha paṛhaba ihāṁra sannidhāne |
niścaẏa jāniha mātā kahila bacane || 704 ||

amarah padhaba — it is we who shall study; ihanra sannidhane — in His presence; nishchaya janiha — know for certain; mata — mother; kahila bachane — we have said (it) in words

704It is we who shall learn in His presence —
know this for certain, mother; we have told you the truth."

শুনি শচীদেবী বৈল বিনয়-বচনে ।
পুত্র সমর্পিয়া আইলা আপন-ভবনে ॥ ৭০৫ ॥

śuni śacīdebī baila binaẏa-bacane |
putra samarpiẏā āilā āpana-bhabane || 705 ||

shuni — hearing; shachidevi baila — Shachi-devi spoke; vinaya-bachane — with humble words; putra samarpiya — entrusting her son; aila apana-bhavane — came back home

705Hearing this, Shachi-devi answered with humble words
and, having entrusted her son, returned to her home.

তবে আর কথোদিনে প্রভু বিশ্বম্ভর ।
পঢ়িবারে গেলা বিষ্ণুপণ্ডিতের ঘর ॥ ৭০৬ ॥

tabe āra kathodine prabhu biśbambhara |
paṛhibāre gelā biṣṇupaṇḍitera ghara || 706 ||

tabe ara kathodine — then after some more days; prabhu vishvambhara — the Lord Vishvambhara; padhibare gela — went to study; vishnu-panditera ghara — at the house of Vishnu Pandita

706Then, after a few more days, the Lord Vishvambhara
went to study at the house of Vishnu Pandita.

সুদর্শন আর গঙ্গাদাস যে পণ্ডিতে ।
পঢ়িলা জগত-গুরু তা সভার হিতে ॥ ৭০৭ ॥

sudarśana āra gaṅgādāsa ye paṇḍite |
paṛhilā jagata-guru tā sabhāra hite || 707 ||

sudarshana ara gangadasa ye pandite — under Sudarshana and the pandit Gangadasa; padhila — studied; jagata-guru — the Teacher of the world; ta sabhara hite — for their good

707Under Sudarshana and the pandit Gangadasa
the Teacher of the world studied — for their own good.

লোক আচরয়ে মায়া-মানুষ-বিগ্রহ ।
পঢ়য়ে পঢ়ায় বিদ্যা লোক-অনুগ্রহ ॥ ৭০৮ ॥

loka ācaraẏe māẏā-mānuṣa-bigraha |
paṛhaẏe paṛhāẏa bidyā loka-anugraha || 708 ||

loka acharaye — behaves like people; maya-manusha-vigraha — He who by yogamaya has a human form; padhaye padhaya vidya — studies and teaches knowledge; loka-anugraha — out of kindness to people

708He who by His yogamaya has manifested a human form2 behaves like people;
out of kindness to people He studies and teaches knowledge.

পণ্ডিত শ্রীসুদর্শন আর একদিনে ।
পরিহাস করে প্রভু সতীর্থের সনে ॥ ৭০৯ ॥

paṇḍita śrīsudarśana āra ekadine |
parihāsa kare prabhu satīrthera sane || 709 ||

pandita sri-sudarshana — [at] Pandita Sri Sudarshana's; ara ekadine — one day; parihasa kare prabhu — the Lord jokes; satirthera sane — with fellow students

709One day, at the school of Pandita Sri Sudarshana,
the Lord jokes with His fellow students.

বঙ্গজের কথা কহে বড়ই রসাল ।
অতি মনোহর হাসি অমিয়া-মিশাল ॥ ৭১০ ॥

baṅgajera kathā kahe baṛai rasāla |
ati manohara hāsi amiẏā-miśāla || 710 ||

bangajera katha kahe — speaks the speech of the East Bengalis; badai rasala — most amusingly; ati manohara hasi — most charming laughter; amiya-mishala — mixed with nectar

710He talks in the speech of the East Bengalis — most amusingly;3
His laughter, full of nectar, captivates the heart.

এইমতে রঙ্গে-ঢঙ্গে কথোদিন গেল ।
বনমালী-আচার্য দেখিব মনে কৈল ॥ ৭১১ ॥

eimate raṅge-ḍhaṅge kathodina gela |
banamālī-ācārya dekhiba mane kaila || 711 ||

eimate — thus; range-dhange — in merry pranks; kathodina gela — some days passed; vanamali-acharya dekhiba — "I shall see Vanamali Acharya"; mane kaila — He decided

711Thus some days passed in merry pranks;
He decided to visit Vanamali Acharya.

তারে দেখিবারে তার আশ্রমেতে গেলা ।
দেখিয়া প্রণতি করি সম্ভ্রমে উঠিলা ॥ ৭১২ ॥

tāre dekhibāre tāra āśramete gelā |
dekhiẏā praṇati kari sambhrame uṭhilā || 712 ||

tare dekhibare — to see him; tara ashramete gela — went to his house; dekhiya — seeing; pranati kari — bowing; sambhrame uthila — rose in reverence

712To see him He went to his house;
seeing [Him], he rose in reverence and bowed.

করে ধরি তার সনে চলি যায় পথে ।
কৌতুক-রহস্য-কথা কহিতে কহিতে ॥ ৭১৩ ॥

kare dhari tāra sane cali yāẏa pathe |
kautuka-rahasya-kathā kahite kahite || 713 ||

kare dhari — taking by the hand; tara sane — with him; chali yaya pathe — walks along the road; kautuka-rahasya-katha — amusing and confidential talk; kahite kahite — talking

713Taking him by the hand, He walks with him along the road,
talking of amusing and confidential things.

হেনকালে বল্লভ সে আচার্যের কন্যা ।
রূপে গুণে শীলে সেই ত্রিজগত-ধন্যা ॥ ৭১৪ ॥

henakāle ballabha se ācāryera kanyā |
rūpe guṇe śīle sei trijagata-dhanyā || 714 ||

hena-kale — at that time; vallabha se acharyera kanya — the daughter of Vallabha Acharya; rupe gune shile — in beauty, virtue, character; sei trijagata-dhanya — famed in the three worlds

714At that time the daughter of Vallabha Acharya,
famed in the three worlds for beauty, virtue and character,

গঙ্গাস্নানে যায় সেই সখীর সহিতে ।
বিশ্বম্ভর হরি তারে দেখে আচম্বিতে ॥ ৭১৫ ॥

gaṅgāsnāne yāẏa sei sakhīra sahite |
biśbambhara hari tāre dekhe ācambite || 715 ||

ganga-snane yaya — goes to bathe in the Ganga; sei sakhira sahite — she with her friends; vishvambhara hari — Vishvambhara Hari; tare dekhe achambite — suddenly sees her

715is going with her friends to bathe in the Ganga;
Vishvambhara Hari suddenly sees her.

একদৃষ্টে চাহে প্রভু সস্মিত আনন ।
দেখিয়া জানিল তার জন্মের কারণ ॥ ৭১৬ ॥

ekadṛṣṭe cāhe prabhu sasmita ānana |
dekhiẏā jānila tāra janmera kāraṇa || 716 ||

eka-drishte chahe prabhu — the Lord gazes steadily; sasmita anana — with a smiling face; dekhiya — seeing; janila — knew; tara janmera karana — the reason of her birth

716The Lord gazes at her steadily with a smiling face
and, seeing her, knew why she had been born.4

লক্ষ্মী ঠাকুরাণী তাহা ইঙ্গিতে বুঝিল ।
প্রভু-পাদপদ্ম দেবী শিরে করি নিল ॥ ৭১৭ ॥

lakṣmī ṭhākurāṇī tāhā iṅgite bujhila |
prabhu-pādapadma debī śire kari nila || 717 ||

lakshmi thakurani — Lakshmi Thakurani; taha ingite bujhila — understood it from the sign; prabhu-padapadma — the Lord's lotus feet; devi — the goddess; shire kari nila — took upon her head

717Lakshmi Thakurani understood this from the sign,
and the goddess took the lotus feet of the Lord upon her head.5

আচার্য সে বনমালী বড়ই চতুর ।
বুঝিল অন্তর-কথা হৃদয়-অঙ্কুর ॥ ৭১৮ ॥

ācārya se banamālī baṛai catura |
bujhila antara-kathā hṛdaẏa-aṅkura || 718 ||

acharya se vanamali — Acharya Vanamali; badai chatura — very shrewd; bujhila antara-katha — understood what was in their hearts; hridaya-ankura — the sprout of the heart

718Acharya Vanamali was very shrewd:
he understood what was in their hearts — the sprouting feeling.

আরদিন বনমালী আচার্য আপনে ।
আনন্দ-হৃদয়ে গেলা শচীর ভবনে ॥ ৭১৯ ॥

āradina banamālī ācārya āpane |
ānanda-hṛdaẏe gelā śacīra bhabane || 719 ||

aradina — the next day; vanamali acharya apane — Vanamali Acharya himself; ananda-hridaye — with joy in his heart; gela shachira bhavane — went to Shachi's house

719The next day Vanamali Acharya himself,
with joy in his heart, went to Shachi's house.

হাসিয়া প্রণাম কৈল শচীর চরণে ।
প্রণতি করিয়া বৈল মধুর-বচনে ॥ ৭২০ ॥

hāsiẏā praṇāma kaila śacīra caraṇe |
praṇati kariẏā baila madhura-bacane || 720 ||

hasiya — smiling; pranama kaila shachira charane — bowed at Shachi's feet; pranati kariya — bowing; baila madhura-bachane — spoke with sweet words

720Smiling, he bowed at Shachi's feet
and, bowing, spoke with sweet words:

তোমার পুত্রের যোগ্য আছে এক কন্যা ।
রূপে গুণে শীলে সেই ত্রিজগতে ধন্যা ॥ ৭২১ ॥

tomāra putrera yogya āche eka kanyā |
rūpe guṇe śīle sei trijagate dhanyā || 721 ||

tomara putrera yogya — worthy of your son; achhe eka kanya — there is a girl; rupe gune shile — in beauty, virtue, character; sei trijagate dhanya — she is famed in the three worlds

721"There is a girl worthy of your son:
for beauty, virtue and character she is famed in the three worlds.

বল্লভ-আচার্য-কন্যা অতি সুচরিতা ।
যদি ইচ্ছা থাকে কহ হৃদয়ের কথা ॥ ৭২২ ॥

ballabha-ācārya-kanyā ati sucaritā |
yadi icchā thāke kaha hṛdaẏera kathā || 722 ||

vallabha-acharya-kanya — Vallabha Acharya's daughter; ati sucharita — very well-mannered; yadi ichchha thake — if there is the wish; kaha hridayera katha — tell what is in your heart

722She is the daughter of Vallabha Acharya, most well-mannered;
if you have the wish, tell me what is in your heart."

তবে শচীদেবী শুনি আচার্য-বচন ।
এ অতি বালক মোর পঢ়ুক এখন ॥ ৭২৩ ॥

tabe śacīdebī śuni ācārya-bacana |
e ati bālaka mora paṛhuka ekhana || 723 ||

tabe shachidevi — then Shachi-devi; shuni acharya-bachana — hearing the Acharya's words; e ati balaka mora — He is still a mere boy; padhuka ekhana — let Him study now

723Hearing the Acharya's words, Shachi-devi [said]:
"He is still just a boy; let Him study now.

পিতৃশূন্য পুত্র মোর পঢ়ুক কথোদিন ।
তাহাতে করহ যত্ন হউক প্রবীণ ॥ ৭২৪ ॥

pitṛśūnya putra mora paṛhuka kathodina |
tāhāte karaha yatna hauka prabīṇa || 724 ||

pitri-shunya putra mora — my fatherless son; padhuka kathodina — let Him study some days; tahate karaha yatna — take care of that; hauka pravina — may He become accomplished

724My son has lost His father — let Him study for some more days;
see to that instead, so that He may become accomplished."

শুনিঞা আচার্য তবে সন্তোষ না পাইল ।
বিরস-বদন হঞা ঘরেতে চলিল ॥ ৭২৫ ॥

śuniñā ācārya tabe santoṣa nā pāila |
birasa-badana hañā gharete calila || 725 ||

shunina — hearing; acharya tabe — the Acharya then; santosha na paila — was not pleased; virasa-badana hina — with a downcast face; gharete chalila — set out for home

725Hearing this, the Acharya was not pleased;
with a downcast face he set out for home.

কান্দিতে কান্দিতে চলে ব্যাকুল অন্তরে ।
হা হা গোরাচাঁদ বলি ডাকে উচ্চৈঃস্বরে ॥ ৭২৬ ॥

kāndite kāndite cale byākula antare |
hā hā gorācāṁda bali ḍāke uccaiḥsbare || 726 ||

kandite kandite chale — goes weeping and weeping; vyakula antare — distressed at heart; ha ha gorachanda bali — crying "O, O Gorachand!"; dake uchchaihsvare — calls aloud

726He goes weeping and weeping, distressed at heart,
calling aloud: "O, O Gorachand!

মোর ভাগ্যে না করিলে পতিতপাবন ।
বাঞ্ছাকল্পতরু নাম ধর কি কারণ ॥ ৭২৭ ॥

mora bhāgye nā karile patitapābana |
bāñchākalpataru nāma dhara ki kāraṇa || 727 ||

mora bhagye — for my lot; na karile — You did not do; patita-pavana — O Purifier of the fallen; vanchha-kalpataru nama — the name "Wish-fulfilling Tree"; dhara ki karana — why do You bear

727You did not do it for my lot, O Purifier of the fallen —
why then do You bear the name 'Wish-fulfilling Tree'?

মোর বাঞ্ছা পূর্ণ যদি না কৈলে আপনে ।
বাঞ্ছাকল্পতরু নাম ধরিবে কেমনে ॥ ৭২৮ ॥

mora bāñchā pūrṇa yadi nā kaile āpane |
bāñchākalpataru nāma dharibe kemane || 728 ||

mora vanchha — my desire; purna yadi na kaile apane — if You Yourself did not fulfil; vanchha-kalpataru nama — the name "Wish-fulfilling Tree"; dharibe kemane — how will You bear

728If You Yourself have not fulfilled my desire,
how will You bear the name 'Wish-fulfilling Tree'?

জয় জয় দ্রৌপদীর লজ্জা-ভয়-হারী ।
জয় গজরাজকে কুম্ভীর-মুখে তারি ॥ ৭২৯ ॥

jaẏa jaẏa draupadīra lajjā-bhaẏa-hārī |
jaẏa gajarājake kumbhīra-mukhe tāri || 729 ||

jaya jaya — glory, glory; draupadira lajja-bhaya-hari — to Him who took away Draupadi's shame and fear; jaya — glory; gajarajake kumbhira-mukhe tari — to Him who saved the king of elephants from the crocodile's jaws

729Glory, glory to You who took away Draupadi's shame and fear!
Glory to You who saved the king of elephants from the crocodile's jaws!

জয় অজামিল-গণিকার ত্রাণদাতা ।
আমারে যে ত্রাণ কর অখিলের পিতা ॥ ৭৩০ ॥

jaẏa ajāmila-gaṇikāra trāṇadātā |
āmāre ye trāṇa kara akhilera pitā || 730 ||

jaya — glory; ajamila-ganikara trana-data — to the giver of deliverance to Ajamila and the courtesan; amare ye trana kara — deliver me too; akhilera pita — Father of all

730Glory to You who gave deliverance to Ajamila and the courtesan!6
Deliver me too, Father of all the world!"

এথা গুরুগৃহে প্রভু জানিল অন্তরে ।
আচার্য শোকেতে যত হঞাছে কাতরে ॥ ৭৩১ ॥

ethā gurugṛhe prabhu jānila antare |
ācārya śokete yata hañāche kātare || 731 ||

etha — meanwhile; guru-grihe — at the teacher's house; prabhu janila antare — the Lord knew in His heart; acharya shokete — the Acharya in grief; yata hinachhe katare — how stricken he was

731Meanwhile, at His teacher's house, the Lord knew in His heart
how stricken with grief the Acharya was.

আস্তে-ব্যস্তে পুস্তক সম্বরি ভগবান্ ।
গুরু সম্ভাষিয়া প্রভু করিলা পয়ান ॥ ৭৩২ ॥

āste-byaste pustaka sambari bhagabān |
guru sambhāṣiẏā prabhu karilā paẏāna || 732 ||

aste-vyaste — hastily; pustaka samvari — gathering His books; bhagavan — Bhagavan; guru sambhashiya — taking leave of His teacher; prabhu karila payana — the Lord set out

732Hastily gathering His books, Bhagavan,
taking leave of His teacher, the Lord set out.

মাতল কুঞ্জর যেন গমন সুন্দর ।
গৌরতনু অলঙ্কারে করে ঝলমল ॥ ৭৩৩ ॥

mātala kuñjara yena gamana sundara |
gauratanu alaṅkāre kare jhalamala || 733 ||

matala kunjara yena — like an intoxicated elephant; gamana sundara — a beautiful gait; gaura-tanu — the golden body; alankare kare jhalamala — sparkles with ornaments

733His gait was beautiful, like that of an intoxicated elephant;
His golden body sparkled with ornaments.

চাঁচর কেশের বেশ অখিল-মোহন ।
অধর বান্ধুলী-ফুল মুকুতা দশন ॥ ৭৩৪ ॥

cāṁcara keśera beśa akhila-mohana |
adhara bāndhulī-phula mukutā daśana || 734 ||

chanchara keshera besha — the arrangement of curling locks; akhila-mohana — enchants the world; adhara bandhuli-phula — lips are bandhuli flowers; mukuta dashana — teeth are pearls

734His curling locks enchant the whole world;
His lips are bandhuli flowers, His teeth pearls.

চন্দনে চর্চিত মনোহর অঙ্গশোভা ।
তনু সূক্ষ্ম বসন পিন্ধন মনোলোভা ॥ ৭৩৫ ॥

candane carcita manohara aṅgaśobhā |
tanu sūkṣma basana pindhana manolobhā || 735 ||

chandane charchita — anointed with sandal; manohara anga-shobha — beautiful limbs; tanu sukshma basana pindhana — fine garments worn on the body; mano-lobha — captivating the heart

735His limbs, anointed with sandal, are beautiful;
on His body fine garments that captivate the heart.

কত কোটি কামের নৃপতি গৌরহরি ।
কুলবতী-কলঙ্ক-বিথার দেহধারী ॥ ৭৩৬ ॥

kata koṭi kāmera nṛpati gaurahari |
kulabatī-kalaṅka-bithāra dehadhārī || 736 ||

kata koti kamera nripati — king of many millions of Kamadevas; gaurahari — Gaurahari; kulavati-kalanka-vithara — spreading disgrace among chaste wives; deha-dhari — bearing [such] a body

736Gaurahari is the king of many millions of Kamadevas,
and His body throws chaste wives into turmoil.7

আচার্য লাগিয়া প্রভুর ত্বরিতে গমন ।
বাঞ্ছাকল্পতরু নাম বলি এ কারণ ॥ ৭৩৭ ॥

ācārya lāgiẏā prabhura tbarite gamana |
bāñchākalpataru nāma bali e kāraṇa || 737 ||

acharya lagiya — for the Acharya's sake; prabhura tvarite gamana — the Lord hastened; vanchha-kalpataru nama — the name "Wish-fulfilling Tree"; bali e karana — is said for this reason

737The Lord hastened for the Acharya's sake —
that is why He is called the "Wish-fulfilling Tree".

আচার্য কান্দিয়া তবে আইসে পথে পথে ।
হা হা গোরাচাঁদ বলি ধায় ঊর্ধ্বহাথে ॥ ৭৩৮ ॥

ācārya kāndiẏā tabe āise pathe pathe |
hā hā gorācāṁda bali dhāẏa ūrdhbahāthe || 738 ||

acharya kandiya — the Acharya weeping; tabe — then; aise pathe pathe — comes from road to road; ha ha gorachanda bali — crying "O, O Gorachand!"; dhaya urdhva-hathe — runs with arms raised

738And the Acharya goes weeping from road to road
and runs with arms raised, crying: "O, O Gorachand!"

হেনকালে মহাপ্রভু গুরুগৃহ হৈতে ।
আসিতে হইল দেখা আচার্য-সহিতে ॥ ৭৩৯ ॥

henakāle mahāprabhu gurugṛha haite |
āsite haila dekhā ācārya-sahite || 739 ||

hena-kale — just then; mahaprabhu guru-griha haite — Mahaprabhu from His teacher's house; asite — coming; haila dekha acharya-sahite — met the Acharya

739Just then Mahaprabhu, coming back from His teacher's house,
met the Acharya.

পড়িলা আচার্য পায় দণ্ডবত হঞা ।
তুলিলেন মহাপ্রভু হাসিয়া হাসিয়া ॥ ৭৪০ ॥

paṛilā ācārya pāẏa daṇḍabata hañā |
tulilena mahāprabhu hāsiẏā hāsiẏā || 740 ||

padila acharya paya — the Acharya fell at His feet; dandavata hina — stretched out like a stick; tulilena mahaprabhu — Mahaprabhu raised him; hasiya hasiya — smiling and smiling

740The Acharya fell at His feet, stretched out like a stick,
and Mahaprabhu, smiling and smiling, raised him up.

নমস্কার করি কৈল গাঢ় আলিঙ্গন ।
কোথা গিয়াছিলা বৈল মধুর বচন ॥ ৭৪১ ॥

namaskāra kari kaila gāṛha āliṅgana |
kothā giẏāchilā baila madhura bacana || 741 ||

namaskara kari — greeting; kaila gadha alingana — embraced tightly; kotha giyachhila — "where had you gone?"; baila madhura bachana — said sweetly

741Greeting him, He embraced him tightly
and asked sweetly: "Where have you been?"

আচার্য কহয়ে শুন শুন বিশ্বম্ভর ।
আমি গিয়াছিলাম এই ঘরেরে তোমার ॥ ৭৪২ ॥

ācārya kahaẏe śuna śuna biśbambhara |
āmi giẏāchilāma ei gharere tomāra || 742 ||

acharya kahaye — the Acharya says; shuna shuna vishvambhara — listen, listen, Vishvambhara; ami giyachhilama — I went; ei gharere tomara — to this house of Yours

742The Acharya says: "Listen, listen, Vishvambhara:
I went to Your house.

তোমার জননী দেবী অতি সুচরিতা ।
গোচর করিলুঁ চিত্তে যে আছিল কথা ॥ ৭৪৩ ॥

tomāra jananī debī ati sucaritā |
gocara kariluṁ citte ye āchila kathā || 743 ||

tomara janani devi — to Your mother, the goddess; ati sucharita — very well-mannered; gochara karilun — I made known; chitte ye achhila katha — what was in my heart

743To Your mother, the goddess, so well-mannered,
I made known what was in my heart:

তোমার বিভার যোগ্যা আছে এক কন্যা ।
বল্লভ-আচার্য-কন্যা সর্বগুণে ধন্যা ॥ ৭৪৪ ॥

tomāra bibhāra yogyā āche eka kanyā |
ballabha-ācārya-kanyā sarbaguṇe dhanyā || 744 ||

tomara vibhara yogya — worthy of marriage with You; achhe eka kanya — there is a girl; vallabha-acharya-kanya — Vallabha Acharya's daughter; sarvagune dhanya — renowned for every virtue

744there is a girl worthy to be Your bride —
the daughter of Vallabha Acharya, renowned for every virtue.

এ কথা তোমার মাতা শুনি শ্রদ্ধাহীন ।
ঘরেরে চলিলাঙ আমি অন্তর-মলিন ॥ ৭৪৫ ॥

e kathā tomāra mātā śuni śraddhāhīna |
gharere calilāṅa āmi antara-malina || 745 ||

e katha — these words; tomara mata shuni — Your mother, hearing; shraddhahina — without regard; gharere chalilanga ami — I am going home; antara-malina — with a heavy heart

745Your mother paid no heed to these words,
and I am going home with a heavy heart."

কিছু না বলিলা প্রভু শুনিঞা বচন ।
মুচকি হাসিয়া ঘরে করিলা গমন ॥ ৭৪৬ ॥

kichu nā balilā prabhu śuniñā bacana |
mucaki hāsiẏā ghare karilā gamana || 746 ||

kichhu na balila prabhu — the Lord said nothing; shunina bachana — hearing the words; muchaki hasiya — smiling playfully; ghare karila gamana — went home

746Hearing this, the Lord said nothing,
but with a playful smile went home.

সে চাতুরী লাবণ্য মধুর মন্দ হাসি ।
হেরিয়া আচার্য মনে হঞা অভিলাষী ॥ ৭৪৭ ॥

se cāturī lābaṇya madhura manda hāsi |
heriẏā ācārya mane hañā abhilāṣī || 747 ||

se chaturi — that playfulness (lit. "cleverness"); lavanya — beauty; madhura manda hasi — soft sweet smile; heriya — seeing; acharya mane hina abhilashi — the Acharya became hopeful at heart

747Seeing that playfulness, that beauty, that soft, sweet smile,
the Acharya was filled with hope:

জানিলেন মোর কার্য অবশ্য হইব ।
অন্তরে জানিল প্রভু বিবাহ করিব ॥ ৭৪৮ ॥

jānilena mora kārya abaśya haiba |
antare jānila prabhu bibāha kariba || 748 ||

janilena — he understood; mora karya — my business; avashya haiba — will surely succeed; antare janila — knew in his heart; prabhu vibaha kariba — the Lord will marry

748"My business will surely succeed," he understood;
he understood in his heart that the Lord would marry.

ঘরেরে আইলা আচার্য আনন্দিত হঞা ।
প্রভুর চরিত্র সব হৃদয়ে ভাবিয়া ॥ ৭৪৯ ॥

gharere āilā ācārya ānandita hañā |
prabhura caritra saba hṛdaẏe bhābiẏā || 749 ||

gharere aila — came home; acharya anandita hina — the Acharya, rejoicing; prabhura charitra saba — all the Lord's doings; hridaye bhaviya — pondering in his heart

749The Acharya came home rejoicing,
pondering in his heart all that the Lord had done.

ঘরে গিয়া জননীরে বৈল বিশ্বম্ভর ।
বনমালী-আচার্যেরে কি দিলা উত্তর ॥ ৭৫০ ॥

ghare giẏā jananīre baila biśbambhara |
banamālī-ācāryere ki dilā uttara || 750 ||

ghare giya — going home; jananire baila vishvambhara — Vishvambhara said to His mother; vanamali-acharyere — to Vanamali Acharya; ki dila uttara — what answer did you give

750Coming home, Vishvambhara said to His mother:
"What answer did you give Vanamali Acharya?

বিমনা দেখিল আমি তারে পথে যাইতে ।
সম্ভাষে না পাইনু সুখ আচার্য-সহিতে ॥ ৭৫১ ॥

bimanā dekhila āmi tāre pathe yāite |
sambhāṣe nā pāinu sukha ācārya-sahite || 751 ||

vimana dekhila ami tare — I saw him downcast; pathe yaite — going along the road; sambhashe na painu sukha — I found no joy in talking; acharya-sahite — with the Acharya

751I saw him going along the road downcast;
talking with the Acharya gave Me no joy.

তার অসন্তোষ কেনে করিয়াছ তুমি ।
বিমনা দেখিয়া তারে দুঃখ পাইলুঁ আমি ॥ ৭৫২ ॥

tāra asantoṣa kene kariẏācha tumi |
bimanā dekhiẏā tāre duḥkha pāiluṁ āmi || 752 ||

tara asantosha — his displeasure; kene kariyachha tumi — why have you caused; vimana dekhiya tare — seeing him downcast; duhkha pailun ami — I was saddened

752Why have you displeased him?
Seeing him downcast, I was saddened."

শুনিয়া পুত্রের বাণী শচী সুচতুরা ।
ইঙ্গিত জানিঞা হৈল হৃদয়-সত্বরা ॥ ৭৫৩ ॥

śuniẏā putrera bāṇī śacī sucaturā |
iṅgita jāniñā haila hṛdaẏa-satbarā || 753 ||

shuniya putrera vani — hearing her son's words; shachi suchatura — the very shrewd Shachi; ingita janina — understanding the hint; haila hridaya-satvara — became eager at heart

753Hearing her son's words, the very shrewd Shachi
understood the hint and made haste.

ত্বরায় মানুষ গেল আচার্য আনিবারে ।
সংবাদ শুনিয়া তেঁহো আইলা সত্বরে ॥ ৭৫৪ ॥

tbarāẏa mānuṣa gela ācārya ānibāre |
saṃbāda śuniẏā teṁho āilā satbare || 754 ||

tvaraya — at once; manusha gela — a man went; acharya anibare — to fetch the Acharya; samvada shuniya — hearing the news; tenho aila satvare — he came quickly

754At once a man went to fetch the Acharya;
hearing the news, he came quickly.

আনন্দে পূরিত তনু গদগদ হঞা ।
শচী-কাছে উপনীত প্রণত হইয়া ॥ ৭৫৫ ॥

ānande pūrita tanu gadagada hañā |
śacī-kāche upanīta praṇata haiẏā || 755 ||

anande purita tanu — body filled with joy; gadagada hina — choked with emotion; shachi-kachhe upanita — came before Shachi; pranata haiya — bowing

755His whole body filled with joy, his voice choked with emotion,
he came before Shachi and bowed.

দণ্ডবত করি লৈল চরণের ধূলি ।
কি কারণে আজ্ঞা মোরে করিলা ঈশ্বরী ॥ ৭৫৬ ॥

daṇḍabata kari laila caraṇera dhūli |
ki kāraṇe ājñā more karilā īśbarī || 756 ||

dandavata kari — prostrating; laila charanera dhuli — took the dust of her feet; ki karane — for what reason; ajna more karila — have you summoned me; ishvari — O mistress

756Prostrating himself, he took the dust of her feet:
"Why have you called me, mistress?"

শুনি শচীদেবী তবে আচার্য-বচন ।
আদর করিয়া তারে কৈল তখন ॥ ৭৫৬+১ ॥

śuni śacīdebī tabe ācārya-bacana |
ādara kariẏā tāre kaila takhana || 756+1 ||

shuni — hearing; shachidevi — Shachi-devi; tabe — then; acharya-vachana — the Acharya's words; adara kariya — with respect; tare — to him; kaila takhana — said then

756+1Hearing the Acharya's words, Shachi-devi
then spoke to him with respect:8

পূর্বে যে কহিলা তার করহ উদ্যোগ ।
বিশ্বম্ভরে বিভা দিব সভার সন্তোষ ॥ ৭৫৭ ॥

pūrbe ye kahilā tāra karaha udyoga |
biśbambhare bibhā diba sabhāra santoṣa || 757 ||

purve ye kahila — what you said before; tara karaha udyoga — arrange it; vishvambhare vibha diba — I shall marry Vishvambhara; sabhara santosha — to everyone's joy

757"What you spoke of before — arrange it;
I shall marry Vishvambhara, to everyone's joy.

আমার অধিক স্নেহ তোর বিশ্বম্ভরে ।
আপনে করিবি সব কি বলিব তোরে ॥ ৭৫৮ ॥

āmāra adhika sneha tora biśbambhare |
āpane karibi saba ki baliba tore || 758 ||

amara adhika sneha — affection greater than mine; tora vishvambhare — you have for Vishvambhara; apane karibi saba — you will do everything yourself; ki baliba tore — what should I tell you

758You love my Vishvambhara more than I do;
you will do everything yourself — what should I tell you?

বিশ্বম্ভর-বিবাহ-নিমিত্তে যে কহিলে ।
আপনে উদ্যোগ কর কহিল তোমারে ॥ ৭৫৯ ॥

biśbambhara-bibāha-nimitte ye kahile |
āpane udyoga kara kahila tomāre || 759 ||

vishvambhara-vibaha-nimitte — for Vishvambhara's marriage; ye kahile — what you said; apane udyoga kara — undertake it yourself; kahila tomare — I tell you

759What you spoke of for Vishvambhara's marriage —
undertake it yourself, I tell you."

ইহা শুনি বনমালী আচার্য-উত্তম ।
পালিব তোমার আজ্ঞা বলিল বচন ॥ ৭৬০ ॥

ihā śuni banamālī ācārya-uttama |
pāliba tomāra ājñā balila bacana || 760 ||

iha shuni — hearing this; vanamali acharya-uttama — Vanamali, the excellent Acharya; paliba tomara ajna — I shall carry out your command; balila bachana — said

760Hearing this, Vanamali, the excellent Acharya,
said: "I shall carry out your command."

ইহা বলি বল্লভ-আচার্য-বাড়ী গেলা ।
বল্লভ-আচার্য অতি সম্ভ্রমে উঠিলা ॥ ৭৬১ ॥

ihā bali ballabha-ācārya-bāṛī gelā |
ballabha-ācārya ati sambhrame uṭhilā || 761 ||

iha bali — saying this; vallabha-acharya-badi gela — went to Vallabha Acharya's house; vallabha-acharya — Vallabha Acharya; ati sambhrame uthila — rose with great respect

761Saying this, he went to the house of Vallabha Acharya;
Vallabha Acharya rose to meet him with great respect,

বসিতে আসন দিল বিনয় করিয়া ।
নিজ ভাগ্য মানি কিছু কহিল হাসিয়া ॥ ৭৬২ ॥

basite āsana dila binaẏa kariẏā |
nija bhāgya māni kichu kahila hāsiẏā || 762 ||

basite asana dila — offered a seat; vinaya kariya — humbly; nija bhagya mani — counting it his good fortune; kichhu kahila hasiya — said smiling

762humbly offered him a seat
and, counting it his good fortune, said with a smile:

বলিল আমার ভাগ্যে তোর আগমন ।
আর কিবা কার্য থাকে কহ ত এখন ॥ ৭৬৩ ॥

balila āmāra bhāgye tora āgamana |
āra kibā kārya thāke kaha ta ekhana || 763 ||

balila — said; amara bhagye — by my good fortune; tora agamana — your coming; ara kiba karya thake — if there is other business; kaha ta ekhana — tell me now

763"By my good fortune you have come to me;
and if there is some other business — tell me now."

বল্লভ-মিশ্রের কথা শুনিঞা আচার্য ।
প্রবন্ধ করিয়া কহে হৃদয়ের কার্য ॥ ৭৬৪ ॥

ballabha-miśrera kathā śuniñā ācārya |
prabandha kariẏā kahe hṛdaẏera kārya || 764 ||

vallabha-mishrera katha — Vallabha Mishra's words; shunina acharya — hearing, the Acharya; prabandha kariya — at length; kahe hridayera karya — tells the business of his heart

764Hearing the words of Vallabha Mishra, the Acharya
set out at length the business of his heart:

সর্বকাল আমারে করহ তুমি স্নেহ ।
স্নেহবশ হঞা আমি আইনু তোর গেহ ॥ ৭৬৫ ॥

sarbakāla āmāre karaha tumi sneha |
snehabaśa hañā āmi āinu tora geha || 765 ||

sarvakala — always; amare karaha tumi sneha — you show me affection; sneha-basha hina — out of affection; ami ainu tora geha — I have come to your house

765"You are always kind to me;
out of affection for you I have come to your house.

মিশ্রপুরন্দর-সুত শ্রীবিশ্বম্ভর ।
কুলে শীলে গুণে সেই সর্বাঙ্গে সুন্দর ॥ ৭৬৬ ॥

miśrapurandara-suta śrībiśbambhara |
kule śīle guṇe sei sarbāṅge sundara || 766 ||

mishra-purandara-suta — the son of Mishra Purandara; sri-vishvambhara — Sri Vishvambhara; kule shile gune — in lineage, character, virtues; sei sarvange sundara — He is beautiful in every way

766The son of Mishra Purandara, Sri Vishvambhara, —
in lineage, character and virtues He is beautiful in every way.

আমি কি কহিতে পারি তার গুণ-কথা ।
একত্র সকল-গুণে গড়িল বিধাতা ॥ ৭৬৭ ॥

āmi ki kahite pāri tāra guṇa-kathā |
ekatra sakala-guṇe gaṛila bidhātā || 767 ||

ami ki kahite pari — can I describe; tara guna-katha — His virtues; ekatra sakala-gune — all virtues together; gadila vidhata — the Creator has fashioned

767Can I describe His virtues?
The Creator has gathered all virtues together in one.

কি কহিব তার গুণ গায় সর্বলোকে ।
শুনিবে তাহার গুণ সর্বলোক-মুখে ॥ ৭৬৮ ॥

ki kahiba tāra guṇa gāẏa sarbaloke |
śunibe tāhāra guṇa sarbaloka-mukhe || 768 ||

ki kahiba tara guna — what shall I say of His virtues; gaya sarvaloke — all people sing them; shunibe tahara guna — you will hear of His virtues; sarvaloka-mukhe — from the mouths of all

768What shall I say of His virtues — all people sing them;
you will hear of them from the mouths of all.

তোমার কন্যার যোগ্য বর বিশ্বম্ভর ।
কহিল সকল যদি মনে লয় তোর ॥ ৭৬৯ ॥

tomāra kanyāra yogya bara biśbambhara |
kahila sakala yadi mane laẏa tora || 769 ||

tomara kanyara yogya bara — a bridegroom worthy of your daughter; vishvambhara — Vishvambhara; kahila sakala — I have said everything; yadi mane laya tora — if it pleases you

769Vishvambhara is a bridegroom worthy of your daughter;
I have said everything — if it pleases your heart."

এ কথা শুনিঞা মিশ্র মনে অনুমানি ।
এ কথা আমার ভাগ্যে কহিলে যে তুমি ॥ ৭৭০ ॥

e kathā śuniñā miśra mane anumāni |
e kathā āmāra bhāgye kahile ye tumi || 770 ||

e katha shunina — hearing this; mishra mane anumani — Mishra, reflecting; e katha — these words; amara bhagye — by my good fortune; kahile ye tumi — you have spoken

770Hearing this, Mishra reflected and said:
"By my good fortune you have spoken these words to me.

আমি ধনহীন কিছু দিবারে না পারি ।
কন্যা একমাত্র মোর আছয়ে সুন্দরী ॥ ৭৭১ ॥

āmi dhanahīna kichu dibāre nā pāri |
kanyā ekamātra mora āchaẏe sundarī || 771 ||

ami dhanahina — I am poor; kichhu dibare na pari — I cannot give anything; kanya ekamatra mora — my only daughter; achhaye sundari — is a beauty

771I am poor, I cannot give anything [as dowry];
I have only one daughter — a beauty.

ইহা জানি আজ্ঞা যবে করহ আপনে ।
কন্যা দিব বিশ্বম্ভর জামাতা-রতনে ॥ ৭৭২ ॥

ihā jāni ājñā yabe karaha āpane |
kanyā diba biśbambhara jāmātā-ratane || 772 ||

iha jani — knowing this; ajna yabe karaha apane — if you yourself direct; kanya diba — I shall give my daughter; vishvambhara jamata-ratane — to Vishvambhara, the jewel of a son-in-law

772Knowing this, if you yourself so direct,
I shall give my daughter to Vishvambhara, a jewel of a son-in-law.

দেব-ঋষি-পিতৃলোকে করিব আনন্দে ।
যবে মোর কন্যা বিভা দিব গৌরচন্দ্রে ॥ ৭৭৩ ॥

deba-ṛṣi-pitṛloke kariba ānande |
yabe mora kanyā bibhā diba gauracandre || 773 ||

deva-rishi-pitri-loke — the gods, rishis and ancestors; kariba anande — I shall gladden; yabe — when; mora kanya vibha diba — I give my daughter in marriage; gaurachandre — to Gaurachandra

773I shall gladden the gods, the rishis and the ancestors
when I give my daughter in marriage to Gaurachandra.

অনেক তপের ফলে হয় হেন কর্ম ।
ততোধিক বন্ধু নাহি কহিল এ মর্ম ॥ ৭৭৪ ॥

aneka tapera phale haẏa hena karma |
tatodhika bandhu nāhi kahila e marma || 774 ||

aneka tapera phale — as the fruit of much austerity; haya hena karma — such a thing comes about; tatodhika bandhu nahi — there is no greater friend; kahila e marma — I have told the heart of it

774Such a thing comes only as the fruit of much austerity;
there is no greater friend than you — I have told you my heart.

এই মনঃকথা মোর রজনী-দিবস ।
প্রকট বদনে কহি নাহিক সাহস ॥ ৭৭৫ ॥

ei manaḥkathā mora rajanī-dibasa |
prakaṭa badane kahi nāhika sāhasa || 775 ||

ei manah-katha mora — this wish of my heart; rajani-divasa — night and day; prakata badane kahi — to say it aloud; nahika sahasa — I had no courage

775This has been my heart's wish day and night,
but I did not dare to say it aloud."

এইমতে দুইজনে কথা নিবড়িল ।
আচার্য শচীর স্থানে সব নিবেদিল ॥ ৭৭৬ ॥

eimate duijane kathā nibaṛila |
ācārya śacīra sthāne saba nibedila || 776 ||

eimate — thus; dui-jane katha nibadila — the two came to an agreement; acharya — the Acharya; shachira sthane saba nivedila — reported everything to Shachi

776Thus the two came to an agreement,
and the Acharya reported everything to Shachi.

শুনিঞা সে শচীদেবী বড় তুষ্ট হৈল ।
বনমালী আচার্যেরে আশীর্বাদ কৈল ॥ ৭৭৭ ॥

śuniñā se śacīdebī baṛa tuṣṭa haila |
banamālī ācāryere āśīrbāda kaila || 777 ||

shunina — hearing; se shachidevi — Shachi-devi; bada tushta haila — was very pleased; vanamali acharyere — Vanamali Acharya; ashirvada kaila — blessed

777Hearing it, Shachi-devi was very pleased
and blessed Vanamali Acharya.

ইষ্ট-কুটুম্ব আনি নিবেদিল কথা ।
আনন্দে ভরল তনু অতি হরষিতা ॥ ৭৭৮ ॥

iṣṭa-kuṭumba āni nibedila kathā |
ānande bharala tanu ati haraṣitā || 778 ||

ishta-kutumba ani — calling friends and kinsfolk; nivedila katha — announced it; anande bharala tanu — her body filled with joy; ati harashita — greatly rejoicing

778Calling her friends and kinsfolk, she made it known to them;
her whole body filled with joy, she rejoiced.

কুটুম্ব সোদর যত সভে আজ্ঞা দিল ।
বিচার করিয়া সভে ভাল ভাল বৈল ॥ ৭৭৯ ॥

kuṭumba sodara yata sabhe ājñā dila |
bicāra kariẏā sabhe bhāla bhāla baila || 779 ||

kutumba sodara yata — all the kinsfolk and brothers; sabhe ajna dila — all gave consent; vichara kariya — having considered; sabhe bhala bhala baila — all said "good, good"

779All the kinsfolk and brothers gave their consent;
having considered it, all said: "Good, good."

Here ends the Pauganda-lila.

✦

Notes

  1. Sarasvati is the goddess of learning and speech; the Lord is the Master of all knowledge (cf. Murari 1.08.12: "husband of Sarasvati").
  2. Literally "maya-manusha-vigraha", "a human form by maya": said of the Lord, maya is His yogamaya; so also in Murari (1.09.3).
  3. Literally "the speech of the bangajas" — natives of East Bengal (cf. Murari 1.09.4). The Lord's forefathers came from Shrihatta, and He loved to mimic the East Bengali accent in jest.
  4. Vallabhacharya's daughter is Lakshmipriya, Lakshmi herself, who appeared in order to become the Lord's consort; Bhaktisiddhanta in his summary (en/18) calls her Lakshmi-devi. Cf. Murari 1.09.7.
  5. That is, she bowed to His feet in her mind. The 1983 edition reads: "took upon her head the dust of the Lord's lotus feet".
  6. Draupadi, wife of the Pandavas, whom Krishna saved from disgrace in the assembly of the Kauravas; the king of elephants is Gajendra (Bhagavata, Canto 8); Ajamila (Bhagavata, Canto 6) was saved by uttering the name of Narayana; the courtesan is probably Pingala (Bhagavata 11.8).
  7. Literally "a body that spreads disgrace among chaste wives", that is, so beautiful that they lose their composure: a motif of Lochana Dasa's nagari-bhava (see en/09, note 9).
  8. V. 756+1 is found only in the 1983 edition (absent from Bhaktisiddhanta's edition); the 1903 edition does not have it.
